mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate environment, as measured by the FEDFUNDS series, indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 1.0%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates for equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 1.0%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand and economic expansion, which drives corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction of HOUST and RSAFS growth (both above 0.5% MoM) fails to predict positive returns in more than 45% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.5%), labor market tightness reduces corporate labor costs and boosts profit margins, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5%, or the Rank IC for the UNRATE < 4.5% condition falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong job growth, as measured by the monthly change in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS), consistently drives consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS is above the 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (the 2017 base index), it signals a contraction in manufacturing and supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC for the INDPRO < 100 condition is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, which triggers risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction of INDPRO < 100 and GDPC1 growth rate < 0.5% (annualized) fails to predict negative returns in more than 45% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market recovery regime (HOUST growth > 0.5% MoM), increased residential construction activity stimulates related sectors and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST growth > 0.5% MoM, or the Rank IC for the HOUST growth condition falls below 0.03.
